name: Passive Resistor — SPI — SOIC
description: Surface mount SPI-interfaced resistor and digital potentiometer components in SOIC-14 packaging.
selection_hints: Verify SPI interface compatibility with system controller requirements.
Confirm the SOIC-14 footprint matches PCB layout requirements.
